record.question: Which Company has launched the "Share the Load" Campaign and achieved Guinness World Records Certificate for 'Largest Laundry Lesson'?
record.explanation: Answer D: Ariel. Ariel’s ‘Share the Load’ campaign is associated with the Guinness record for a largest laundry lesson; it is not Surf Excel, Tide, or Rin. Reference: https://www.guinnessworldrecords.com/world-records/largest-laundry-lesson. Verified worked solution, unofficial. Historical context: June 2019 (cover; exact day not printed). Officeholders, survey results and forecasts refer to that original paper, not necessarily the present. No matching examiner key is asserted.
